content: Ibn Turka continues by referring to earlier attempts to plumb the esoteric heritage of the Imams, which comprises total knowledge of past, present and future but remains the sole preserve of the Pillars of the Prophetic House (asāṭīn-i ahl-i bayt), i.e. ʿAlī and his sons, who left the technique of jafr.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
